title: Sixty Frames Out
caption: High-energy hyperpop electro-pop with drum-and-bass breakbeats at 140 BPM. Bright, confident, clear female pop lead vocal with attitude, every word crisp and intelligible, plus a shouted gang-chant hook. Fast rolling amen breakbeat, punchy kick and snare, deep wobbling sub bass, huge supersaw chords, glitchy pitched vocal chops, sparkling arps, a big white-noise riser into a euphoric drop. Glossy, loud, fun, futuristic club energy.
lyrics:
[intro]
One sentence in

[verse]
Type it out, hit enter
Watch the letters come alive
Every word becomes a picture
Every beat a brand new vibe

[chorus]
One sentence in, sixty frames out
One sentence in, sixty frames out
Make it move, make it loud
One sentence in, sixty frames out

[bridge]
Render, render, ready, go

[outro]
Sixty frames out
